subject: Post-call: Redwood integration recap & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Jacobs <ben.jacobs@acme.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Redwood integration recap & next steps

Hi Ben & Priya,

Thanks again for taking the time today — great conversation. Quick recap of the pain points and the integration scope we discussed so we all have the same picture: 

Pain points / goals
- Chat responses are too slow for your live support product (95th pctl latency spikes during peak).
- Need structured outputs (JSON payloads) from assistant to feed downstream fulfillment and analytics.
- Want embeddings + reranking to improve search relevance for KB & past tickets.
- Require safe tool invocation (function calling) to limit actions via allowed surface (no arbitrary external calls).

Product-fit / integration notes we covered
- SDK changes: minimal breaking changes planned. We can branch a compatibility shim for your client to test streaming + structured outputs.
- Streaming: runtime supports streaming tokens and event-level framing; this should reduce perceived latency for users.
- Function calling: we support typed function schemas and will include a server-side policy layer to restrict tool access.
- Embeddings & reranking: recommend a two-stage pipeline (embedding similarity + lightweight reranker) — we can provide example evals.

Action items / next steps
1) Marissa: share MAP (attached) and SDK change-log draft (attached).
2) Dev: provide a short PoC branch and code sample for streaming + function calling by EOW Friday.
3) Acme: confirm compliance requirements (data residency / SSO) and provide a sample ticket that needs structured output mapping.
4) Schedule follow-up technical call with your engineering team — propose Wed 5/26 10am PT.

Attachments: ACME-MAP-v1.xlsx, redwood-sdk-change-log.md

If I missed anything, shout. Otherwise I’ll send calendar invite for Wed and loop in our solutions engineer.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
From: Ben Jacobs <ben.jacobs@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Redwood integration recap & next steps

Thanks Marissa — that looks right from our side. A couple clarifications / priorities so we can focus the PoC: 

1) Priority order: embeddings/reranking (search relevance) first, streaming for chat UX second. Structured outputs are critical for fulfillment but can be versioned after we validate reranker improvements.
2) Data residency: for sensitive customer data we need logs retained in the US only. Can Redwood confirm region controls for logs & KV caches?
3) SSO & provisioning: our security team will need to validate SAML config + SCIM for provisioning.

We’ll attach a sample ticket and a mapping doc for the structured output we need (will send separately). Wed 5/26 10am PT works for a short engineering sync.

Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Redwood integration recap & next steps

Marissa / Rishi — quick feasibility note after reviewing the call notes: 

- Streaming: straightforward. We'll expose the existing streaming API via the SDK with a small client-side helper to reassemble events into structured pieces. ETA: PoC branch + sample consumer by EOW (5/28).
- Structured outputs: recommend using our typed function-calling schema; we can add a validation layer on the Redwood side that enforces the JSON schema before forwarding to your fulfillment system. This will avoid malformed payloads hitting your pipelines.
- Function calling / safety: we'll add an allowlist for function names + sandboxed runtime for any external calls. No runtime exec on your side required.
- Embeddings & reranking: I’ll run a quick eval against the sample KB you provide. Expect a short report (precision/recall) and a suggested embedding model + reranker config by 5/31.

Risks / blockers:
- Data residency / logging: we need confirmation if Acme requires dedicated Private deployment or if per-request region routing is sufficient. If Private is required, provisioning lead time is ~6 weeks.
- SSO/SCIM: Ops will need SAML metadata + SCIM provisioning endpoint to validate.

I’ll open a PR with the SDK change-log and a short code sample for streaming + function-calling by EOW and paste the link here when ready.

—
Dev Patel
Senior Software Engineer, Inference Runtime
dev.patel@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Jacobs <ben.jacobs@acme.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Redwood integration recap & next steps

Appreciate the fast follow-ups, everyone. Updated plan based on internal notes and Acme priorities: 

1) Immediate (this week)
- Dev: PoC branch & streaming/function-calling sample by 5/28.
- Marissa: send calendar invite for Wed 5/26 10am PT (scheduled) and share MAP + SDK draft (attached).

2) Short-term (next 1-2 weeks)
- Run embedding eval on sample KB (Dev) — report by 5/31.
- Security: SAML metadata request (Acme) + confirm data residency requirement. If Acme needs US-only logs, Ops will scope Private vs region routing.

3) Mid-term (post-eval)
- Rollout plan: canary streaming on a small percentage of traffic, A/B reranker test, then full rollout.

Links & attachments:
- MAP: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AcmeExampleMAP
- DocuSign skeleton for terms: https://www.docusign.com/ACME-terms-skeleton
- Attachments: ACME-MAP-v1.xlsx, redwood-sdk-change-log.md

Ben / Priya — please confirm the SAML/SCIM contacts and whether US-only logs are required so we can finalize environment scoping. Looking forward to Wednesday's call.

Thanks,
